MODEL POLICY

Harbor Lights Act.

Section 1 (Title):

This act shall be known as the Synthetic Harbor Lights Act.

Section 2 (Summary):

This invented summary says what the approaches below would do for harbors.

It runs to a second paragraph that no bill would carry.

Section 3 (Approaches):

1) (Beacon Review) This invented approach has the harbor master review beacons.

a) Sample language:

i) The [STATE] harbor master shall review each beacon every [X MONTHS].

ii) A beacon found dark shall be relit within [specify a number of] days.

b) Examples include: AA Code 1-2-3, BB HB 9

2) (Keeper Training) This invented approach trains keepers.

a) Suggested language: The harbor master shall train each keeper before the season opens.

b) Examples include: CC SB 10
